title: Precision scrub
description: A compact numerical field sets the spacing of a white typographic specimen on a deep plum proofing surface.
useCase: Space-efficient numerical editing with direct scrubbing, precise entry, and reversible gestures.
interaction: Drag the value, click to type, or use arrow keys; Shift accelerates and Alt refines
reducedMotion: Values and typesetting update directly; the small boundary response settles immediately.
limitations: A local letter-spacing control bounded from -3 to 12 pixels; no pointer lock or document editor integration.
look: Deep plum surface with a large off-white sans-serif specimen word between faint guide lines, above a small outlined monospace value chip and reset icon.
motion: Dragging the chip scrubs letter-spacing live at 0.1 px per pixel (Shift faster, Alt finer); overshooting the -3 to 12 range nudges the chip, which eases back in 180 ms.
adapt: Scrub math is in the chip's `onPointerMove` (multipliers `0.025`, `0.5`, `0.1`; 4 px dead zone) feeding `change`; the -3 to 12 bounds repeat in `clamp`, the drag and arrow keys. Replace `tracking` and the `letterSpacing` specimen with your own value.
